strategies.mutation_rule: Before sealing the contract, trace each proposed behavior, exclusion, preservation guarantee, compatibility boundary, and acceptance case to repository evidence. Where evidence is absent or conflicting, investigate the actual execution path and tests, then obtain an owner decision, approved default, or constrained delegation; never infer narrower scope or implementation boundaries from silence, reports, or hypotheses.
strategies.change_summary: Adds an evidence-first closure gate that requires execution-path and test discovery before unresolved behavior-changing boundaries can enter the contract.

strategies.mutation_rule: For every behavior-changing boundary or technical choice, ask the owner a focused question; if unanswered, present a labeled default for explicit approval or delegate the decision by naming the implementer, constraints, and required evidence. Never infer exclusions, preservation guarantees, acceptance matrices, or narrower scope from missing evidence, and keep unresolved assumptions outside the executable contract.
strategies.change_summary: Adds a single decision-resolution gate centered on owner questions, approved defaults, and constrained delegation, preventing unsupported requirements and compatibility boundaries from entering the contract.
